opis: PANEL 1 (top left): the BUNNY on the sunny meadow happily flies his ORANGE SQUARE KITE - a square standing on its corner, two crossed sticks, a tail of three bows red, orange and yellow - holding the string, the kite high in the blue sky. PANEL 2 (top right): a sudden strong GUST - leaves and petals whirl, the BUNNY's long ears are blown back, the string slips out of his paws, his mouth open in an "oh no!". PANEL 3 (the wide one below): the orange square kite sails far away over the treetops towards a distant PLAYGROUND with a red slide and swings; on the meadow the BUNNY, the FOX and the small HEDGEHOG, seen small from behind, point after it. Windy and lively, not scary.
